cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:df.title: VP of Operations - HVAC
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:df.description: Position Summary The Vice President of Operations is accountable for the design, execution, and ongoing effectiveness of the company’s operational system, including construction, service, and project management functions. This role ensures that work is planned, executed, and completed profitably, predictably, and to standard, replacing informal coordination and personality-driven decision-making with clear accountability, documented processes, and measurable performance.
responsibilities: 1. Operational Performance & Margin Accountability
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for overall operational performance across construction, service, and project management.
This includes accountability for :
Enforcing standardized execution practices across all operational functions
Preventing margin erosion from labor overruns, rework, and missed change orders
Ensuring disciplined job and project kickoff, execution, and closeout
Aligning operational capacity with committed workload
2. Leadership of Operations Management Team
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for the effectiveness and accountability of the Construction Director, Service Director, and Project Manager.
This includes accountability for:
Clear role definition and performance expectations for each direct report
Coaching leaders to manage through systems, KPIs, and cadence
Enforcing accountability without bypassing the chain of command
Developing leadership depth and succession readiness
3. Project Management Control
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for disciplined project execution across applicable work.
Clear project ownership and authority
Standardized project lifecycle control (authorization → plan → execute → close)
Schedule integrity and scope control
Prevention of undocumented or unpaid work
4. Operational Planning & Coordination
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for ensuring work is planned realistically and executed reliably.
Capacity planning across construction and service operations
Coordination between project management and field execution
Prevention of overcommitment and reactive rescheduling
Maintaining a consistent operational cadence
5. Process Ownership & Standardization
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for defining and enforcing the company’s operational standard work.
Defining SOPs for critical operational functions
Ensuring SOPs are trained, used, and enforced
Eliminating variation that creates inefficiency or risk
Supporting continuous improvement without disrupting execution
6. Operational Reporting & Leadership Visibility
The Vice President of Operations is accountable for providing leadership with accurate, timely, and actionable operational information.
Defining operational KPIs across construction, service, and project management
Conducting weekly operational reviews with direct reports
Managing by exception when results are out of range
Providing transparent upward reporting to executive leadership
qualifications: Qualifications
Experience
Minimum 10 years of operations leadership experience
HVAC, plumbing, or construction industry experience strongly preferred
Demonstrated success managing operations through metrics and systems
Knowledge & Skills
Bachelor’s degree in business, Construction Management, Engineering, or related field
(or equivalent experience)
Strong operational judgment
Ability to enforce standards consistently
Clear written and verbal communication
Independent decision-making with appropriate escalation

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:4c7.description: For over two decades, MotoSport has led the powersports industry with unmatched selection, quality, and expertise. Since our founding in 1999, we’ve been driven by one mission — to make your next ride your best ride. As a premier powersports retail e-commerce company, we’re dedicated to providing riders of all types with high-quality parts, gear, and accessories from the most trusted brands. When you reach out to us, you’re not just talking to a salesperson — you’re connecting with someone who rides, wrenches, and lives the lifestyle. We are committed to providing the highest level of service in the powersports industry. For us, that means staffing knowledgeable Senior Motorcycle Technician who is passionate about the industry and ready and waiting to consistently deliver upon that commitment. As a technician, you will be responsible for performing inspections, diagnosis, repairs, maintenance, and installations efficiently and according to the dealership’s quality, safety, and time standards. Primary objectives include ensuring customer satisfaction and retention by fixing units correctly on the first visit. This role may also be required to provide support to entry-level technicians on an as-needed basis. Reports to: Service Manager Location: Roanoke, VA

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:467533db-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: Gen is seeking an adaptable, high-energy Contract Global Customer Care Recruiter to support high-volume front line hiring, with a strong focus on building monthly training classes and maintaining consistent hiring velocity. This role is ideal for a recruiter who thrives in fast-fill environments and knows how to move candidates efficiently through a high-touch, streamlined process without compromising quality or candidate experience. The role is hybrid and based out of the Tempe, AZ office, with an expectation of 3 days per week onsite. This recruiter will partner closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and interview teams to deliver hiring outcomes for recurring class-based starts and ongoing business demand. Success in this role requires strong full-cycle recruiting capability, proactive pipeline management, comfort with high applicant flow, and the ability to create structure, urgency, and consistency across every stage of the hiring process. The ideal candidate brings experience hiring for high-volume front line roles in environments such as customer support, sales, operations, or other fast-paced teams that hire in cohorts. They are highly organized, metrics-driven, and confident using AI-enabled sourcing tools and modern ATS platforms such as Ashby to improve speed, visibility, and decision-making. This recruiter will play a critical role in helping Gen meet hiring goals, fill monthly training classes, and deliver a candidate experience that is efficient, engaging, and aligned to Gen’s brand. Key Responsibilities: - Manage a high-volume requisition load focused on front line hiring and recurring class-based starts. - Build, launch, and maintain talent pipelines that support monthly training classes and ongoing hiring demand. - Drive full-cycle recruiting for high-volume roles, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, debrief facilitation, offer support, and pre-start follow-up. - Develop efficient sourcing strategies to generate active candidate flow, including job boards, resume database mining, referrals, local market outreach, and passive-candidate engagement where appropriate. - Leverage AI-enabled tools, data insights, and ATS capabilities such as Ashby to improve workflow efficiency, pipeline visibility, and conversion rates. - Partner closely with hiring managers to calibrate hiring profiles, align on class size and start dates, and maintain urgency against hiring timelines. - Run structured, repeatable hiring processes that support speed, consistency, and quality at scale. - Track funnel health across key stages, identify bottlenecks e

hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:3eebed78-c8b8-49ae-99d.title: VP Finance and Investments
hexa-hexa:ashbyhq:3eebed78-c8b8-49ae-99d.description: ABOUT HEXA Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We're a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds: 60+ companies created (including 3 unicorns), among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We're entering a special chapter. After 15 years building companies from scratch, Hexa is scaling: expanding our Ventures activity across Europe (Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint, taking entrepreneurs from zero to one) and growing Hexa Scale, our PE program that takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. We're hiring a VP FInance and Investments to structure the financing strategy of the holding company and play a central role in Scale's deal-making. It's a StratCo seat internally and a key point of contact for our investors externally, at a moment when the shape of Hexa for the next years is being decided. THE MISSION You'll be a strategic partner to the CEO and the Hexa Partners, sitting at the intersection of finance and deal-making strategy. You'll drive the financing of the holding company, own the relationship with our shareholders, and bring analytical firepower to Scale's investment decisions (including a seat on the board of several portfolio companies). Think Swiss Army knife: equally at home in a financial model, a deal structuring conversation, an incentive mechanism, or a banking negotiation. WHAT YOU'LL OWN I/ Financing & holding strategy - Define and execute the financing strategy at the holding level (debt, equity, hybrid instruments) - Manage the shareholder relationship: cap table structuring, capital operations, reporting - Manage banking relationships and the group's financial partners - Steer treasury and capital allocation across the three tracks - Build and maintain the group's reference financial models - Manage a small team handling Hexa FP&A, operational LP management and regulatory matters II/ Deal-making & investments (Scale) - Key contributor to Hexa Scale's investment decisions: due diligence analysis, BP, valuation, modeling - Challenge the structure of deals (majority acquisitions, term sheets, governance mechanisms) - Design incentive schemes (management packages, carried interest on the investment-team side, leaver provisions) - Sit on the board of a few portfolio companies ABOUT YOU - You've spent 6-8 years in finance, including at least 3-4 years in investment banking (M&A, leveraged finance) or in an investment fund (investment team / deal team). - You're just as comfortable building a financial model as you are structuring a deal, designing incentives, or negotiating with a bank. - You're analytical and a fast learner, able to quickly get up to speed on new and heterogeneous topics. - You thrive in a fast-paced, low-structure environment. - You take full ownership and think strategically, rather than waiting for a playbook. - You've spent enough time in the tech and startup ecosystem to know how it works and speak its language. - You're bilingual French / English. - You're based in Paris.

You will also contribute to data stewardship, metadata, lineage, classification, and governance maturity initiatives. lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:197c8486-2.title: Founding Account Executive
lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:197c8486-2.description: ABOUT LIGHTFIELD Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. The market agrees. Over 5,000 companies have used Lightfield since we launched in November, making us the fastest-adopted product in our category. We are backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, and Coatue, and our founders previously built Tome, a generative AI presentation product used by over 25 million people. Before Lightfield, our team worked on Llama, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Pinterest, Google, and Salesforce. ABOUT THE ROLE We've shipped a product that founders love, with over 5,000 companies signing up since our launch in November, and aggressively scaling our direct sales motion. Lightfield has strong product-led traction in self-serve—now we need someone who can turn that signal into $20K+ deals with Series A/B startups. This is a founding role. You won't inherit a playbook or a team, but you will inherit real demand. We have a growing base of multi-seat accounts, active teams, and high-intent signals waiting to be worked. The pipeline is there; we need someone who can convert it. You'll mine our PLG data for high-potential accounts, layer in targeted outbound into VC-backed startups, and own the full sales cycle from first meeting through close. You'll report directly to the Head of GTM. In the near term, you'll be the entire sales motion—writing talk tracks, building pilot frameworks, and closing deals. Over time, you'll help define what the sales org looks like as we scale upmarket. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the full sales cycle. Run discovery, demo, pilot, and close for $20K–$50K deals with 30 day cycles. Your buyers are VP Sales, RevOps leads, and technical founder-CEOs at 20–250 person startups. - Work the pipeline we already have—and build on top of it. We have hundreds of active accounts with team adoption, multi-seat usage, and CRM migration signals. You'll enrich and prioritize that existing base, then layer in targeted outbound into Series A/B portfolios to build 3–4x pipeline coverage. - Shape the sales playbook. Build the pilot templates, mutual action plans, and collateral that become the foundation for the team that follows. - Run pilots that convert. Design and execute pilots with co-authored success criteria. Keep them tight—if pilots linger, deals die. - Be the market signal for the company. Synthesize what you hear from prospects—objections, competitive positioning, feature gaps—into actionable insights for product and GTM leadership. BENEFITS & PERKS - Competitive salary - Meaningful early equity - Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) - 3 weeks of PTO - 11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break - 3 months of paid family leave - Wednesdays work from home - Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats - 401k plan - Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5150094.title: Counsel, Applied Legal Research (Singapore)
southparkcommons-centari:ashbyhq:5150094.description: ABOUT CENTARI At Centari, we're transforming the world's contracts into actionable intelligence. Every firm has the same AI now. What separates them is institutional intelligence: how the firm has structured deals, priced risk, and navigated markets across every transaction it has closed. It's why a client picks one law firm over another, and why an LP backs one fund over the next. Today, this knowledge sits buried in closed deals and in the heads of the people who worked on them. Centari brings it to the surface as structured data that AI can act on, empowering companies to generate new revenue and see opportunities no one else can. The most demanding transactional practices in the world already build on Centari, including deal teams at Ropes & Gray, DLA Piper, Willkie, Fried Frank, and Wilson Sonsini. We proved it in law. Finance and the enterprise face the same problem at greater scale, and we're going after all of it. We raised an oversubscribed Series A from investors including Sentinel Global, GTMfund, South Park Commons, Jack Altman, RiverPark Capital, and Recall Capital, and now we're building the team to match our ambition. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring an experienced transactional attorney to join our Applied Legal Research team. In this role, you will apply your corporate law background to the frontlines of building generative AI applications for the world's leading firms. You will work closely with Centari's Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to advance our best-in-class data extraction platform for sophisticated legal work. This role will be a good fit if you are eager to shape the future of generative AI for legal services through your exceptional problem-solving capabilities, knowledge of transactional law, and bias for action. WHAT YOU'LL DO To advance our Deal Intelligence platform, you will: - Develop subject-matter expertise to support AI research in transactional law - Prompt engineer and fine-tune large language models for legal applications - Build proprietary benchmarks to evaluate model performance - Tackle unsolved AI problems in document analysis and legal reasoning - Contribute to improving our data extraction capabilities WHAT YOU HAVE - LL.B., J.D., or equivalent - Singapore qualified lawyer (or other recognized common law jurisdiction) with minimum 3 years PQE. - Significant legal experience at a reputable local or international law firm. Experience with debt finance, funds, and complex M&A transactions is a plus. - Exceptional technical aptitude. While no coding experience is required, you must have a high level of comfort with learning cutting-edge systems. - Proven interest in prompt engineering and leveraging LLMs for legal work. - A generalist mindset and adaptability to quickly learn new areas of law. - As an independent contractor, the ideal candidate is a proactive, solutions-oriented, and independent self-starter who is comfortable operating with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment. - Some collaboration time with US East Coast or West Coast from Monday to Thursday. WHAT WE OFFER - Build at the frontier of AI for knowledge work, with a highly engaged user base from top firms. - Hybrid remote/office culture. - Flexible PTO. For more information, check out centari.com http://centari.com or find us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/centariapp/posts/?feedView=all.

southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:4071f.title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
southparkcommons-junior-ai:ashbyhq:4071f.description: 👶 ABOUT JUNIOR We're building cutting-edge LLM-powered tools that supercharge investment research for the world's most demanding deal teams. Our clients include several of the top 10 global private equity firms, Big 4 professional services firms, and leading consulting practices: organisations responsible for deploying billions of dollars annually. We're a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of ~28 people based in London and New York. We 10x'd our revenue in 2025 and are on track to grow 2-3x again this year. Junior saves clients an average of 10 hours per week, and we're expanding fast into new verticals including investment banking, hedge funds, and research firms. 💡 ROLE DESCRIPTION As one of our first AI/ML hires, you'll have the unique opportunity to: - Work on groundbreaking projects involving a mix of LLMs and traditional ML - Come up with novel research synthesis ideas using NLP techniques and prove their business value - Collaborate closely with our external partners to fuel our growth - Contribute to product decisions, direction and prioritization - Shape our engineering culture We’re live with >20 enterprise clients, and already have 10s of thousands of calls on our platform. There’s lots of data to improve on and build. 🔧 SAMPLE SET OF PROJECTS - Build a search ranking algorithm across open text, integrating signals from user interactions (e.g., edits, copies, and engagement metrics) alongside semantic and PostgreSQL-based text search to improve relevance and ranking across multiple features. - Build your coworker: build an in-house prompt system that can use production signals or human labels to constantly and iteratively refine and improve prompts and output - Build and open source a benchmark for evaluating LLM output on investment research specific tasks - Build an agentic entity deduping system that uses signals from within the app and valuable external data sources / google to clean up the last mile of great STT output: entity resolution - Build a knowledge graph custom to every research sprint that begins as highly unstructured interview data and leverages agentic infrastructure to pull in data where necessary and constantly rebalance the graph and the derived output. 🔥 ABOUT YOU We're looking for product-minded ML engineers who: - Based in NYC - Are opinionated about their work and eager to contribute to product decisions - Have strong communication skills and a desire for a client-facing role - Are able to break down AI/ML problems for a non-technical audience clearly and succinctly, and translate their suggestions into testable experiments. - Have experience building LLM systems from the ground up in a product-focused organization, and can help drive everything from data gathering / logging → prompt optimizing - Have a strong bias to action, highly organised and experienced working with senior stakeholders to deliver large projects end to end - Excited to build a team 🌵 BENEFITS All the usual benefits (competitive pay and equity, private healthcare etc). Unusual benefits: - Gym membership - In-office cook - Summers working in Greece by the beach 📩 HOW TO APPLY If you're excited about the opportunity to drive innovation at Junior, we'd love to hear from you! We can't wait to meet you! 🙌
